title: polygala amara subsp. amblyptera
intro: Polygala amara subsp. amblyptera, commonly known as Balkan milkwort, is a plant species belonging to the Polygalaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Balkan milkwort include bronchodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
